speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We were liked. That is the whole of the three nights. I am not writing Richmond into a letter that has to go in the frost.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She laughed at Pope. Once. Aloud. If I write the laugh twice it becomes a boast, and a boast is a longer letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The brook. I work in London. I live where you are. I had six other sentences and they were the same sentence in a coat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine pounds more. I will not write the box. I will not write a house. The pane can tell her when a pane goes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shorter than I want. That is the letter. Now the sheet.
